name: Whitening & Anti-Cavity Toothpaste
shortDescription: A dual-action paste that lifts stains while remineralising enamel against decay.
description: When you want both. Our dual-action paste pairs micro-polishing silica with fluoride and a remineralising mineral complex — so you don't have to choose between whiter teeth and stronger ones. Designed for daily use, formulated to dentist-aligned standards.
howToUse: Apply a pea-sized amount to a soft-bristled brush.
Brush in small circles for two minutes, twice daily.
Spit, don't rinse — let the fluoride keep working.
Visible whitening in 2–4 weeks with consistent use.
highlights: Whitens and protects in one paste
